svg.title: Sharing: how a link is made, used and cancelled (step M7, built)
svg.desc: Alice presses Share. Her browser makes a secret owner key once and sends it to the collab server, which keeps only its fingerprint and makes her the owner. The server signs a link token with its own secret, carrying the project, the role, an optional expiry and the current generation. Alice sends Bob the link. Bob's browser opens it, remembers it, and connects; the server checks the signature, expiry, project and generation, and makes the connection read-only for a viewer link. If Alice cancels all links, the generation goes up, everyone is disconnected, and old links are refused.
svg.text: Sharing: make a link, use it, cancel it
Built in step M7 (stage A of the permissions: whoever has the link has its role). Accounts (step M8) are the other way in.
ALICE (THE OWNER) MAKES A LINK
1. Share, Create link
Her browser makes a secret owner
key (once, kept in her browser) and
asks: edit or view only, how long.
The first request makes her owner.
2. The collab server
Keeps only a fingerprint of her key.
Signs a token with ITS secret: the
project, role, expiry and generation.
The browser never sees that secret.
3. The link
An address: the project, the server,
the token and the scene. She sends it
to Bob. Her own project goes online
with a link of her own.
BOB OPENS IT
4. His browser
Makes the project for that scene,
remembers the link (so opening the
project later reconnects) and goes
online.
5. The server checks the link
Signature, not expired, right project,
current generation. A viewer link gives
a read-only connection; files can be
downloaded but not uploaded.
6. In the editor
"Online". For a viewer: "Online, view
only", and a change he makes is put
back; Edit points, Paint and Bake say
why they are not allowed.
Cancel all links (only Alice's key can)
The project moves to the next generation. Every link made before is refused, for documents and for files, and everyone
connected is disconnected at once. Alice gets a new link of her own and stays online; new links work as before.
Limits of this stage
Lose the owner key (clear the browser) and no more links can be made. Whoever holds a link has its role. Members and invitations need accounts (M8).
